title: lapsana communis subsp. pinnatisecta
intro: Lapsana communis subsp. pinnatisecta, commonly known as Cut-leaved Nopales, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cut-leaved Nopales include its ability to reduce fever, soothe coughs, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
